heading: Sense of Senate that lobbying expenses should remain nondeductible

tree.heading: Findings
tree.text: The Senate finds that ordinary Americans generally are not allowed to deduct the costs of communicating with their elected representatives.

tree.heading: Sense of Senate
tree.text: It is the sense of the Senate that lobbying expenses should not be tax deductible.

notes.text: Effective DateSection effective Jan. 1, 1996, see section 24 of Pub. L. 104–65, set out as a note under section 1601 of this title.
